basics.type: Private university, formerly Tula's Institute (AICTE-approved since 2006; trust founded 2004)
basics.other: B.Tech (CSE, AI & ML, Data Science, Cyber Security, Civil, Mechanical, ECE, EEE), MBA, BBA, BCA, MCA, B.Pharm, law and B.Sc Agriculture; Mechanical accredited by NBA

admission: Class 12 with Physics, Maths and one listed subject, 45% (40% reserved); some branches ask 60% in PCM
Valid JEE Main, state CET or university entrance test score; lateral entry for diploma holders

scholarships.text: A student diversity scholarship on tuition for all-India students, plus merit scholarships by Class 12 marks in four bands from 60% to above 91%.

hostel.text: On-campus hostels; hostel fee is paid along with the academic fee.

fees.text: Tulas publishes a semester-wise fee table on each B.Tech page. Ask us for the current fee for your course.
